item.title: A Texas cliff has yielded evidence that Indigenous communities drove bison over its edge repeatedly
item.description: Recent archaeological discoveries have uncovered that Indigenous peoples utilized cliffs as bison jumps for millennia. The Nighthawk site in Texas showcases bison remains from various hunting events, demonstrating the importance of these communal hunts in shaping social and political dynamics within communities. Evidence also indicates that hunters revisited this site across generations, refining their tools and strategies, challenging previous assumptions about bison hunting in the Southern Plains. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
